meta.name: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program
meta.attribution: Earthquake data: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS)
meta.expected_latency: Automatic solutions typically within minutes; reviewed solutions hours to days later

coverage.geographic: Global (M4.5+ worldwide; smaller events primarily in the U.S. and territories)
coverage.temporal: Real-time feeds: past hour to past 30 days. FDSN catalog: 1900 to present

meta.resolution: Point hypocentres; location uncertainty typically 1–10 km
meta.historical_depth: ComCat catalog via FDSN event web service
meta.rate_limits: No published hard limit. Summary feeds are CDN-cached; ATLAS polls once per minute and uses conditional requests.

reliability.rationale: Authoritative national seismic network with global coverage and reviewed solutions

limitations: Magnitudes and locations of 'automatic' events are routinely revised.
Small events outside the U.S. are not catalogued in real time.
PAGER alert levels are estimates of shaking-related losses, not observations.

meta.name: GDACS — Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System
meta.provider: European Commission Joint Research Centre & UN OCHA

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY)
license.notes: GDACS states its information is indicative and must not be used for decision making without alternate sources.

meta.attribution: Alerts: GDACS (European Commission JRC & UN OCHA), CC BY
meta.expected_latency: Earthquake alerts typically within 30 minutes of origin; cyclone alerts per advisory cycle
meta.resolution: Event centroids, wind-buffer and affected-area polygons where published
meta.historical_depth: Archive back to 2000s via SEARCH endpoint
meta.rate_limits: No published limit. ATLAS polls every 10 minutes and fetches geometry only for changed events.
meta.cache_strategy: TTL 9 min for event list; geometry cached per episode

reliability.rationale: Inter-agency system; alert levels are model-based impact estimates

limitations: Alert levels are automated impact-model estimates (MODEL provenance), not damage observations.
GDACS earthquake parameters are derived from NEIC/USGS and are not independent confirmation.
Wildfire and drought events are aggregated from GWIS and GDO respectively.

meta.name: NASA EONET — Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker

license.name: NASA open data (no restrictions); constituent sources retain their terms

meta.attribution: Natural events: NASA EONET
meta.update_interval: Varies by upstream source (minutes to days)
meta.expected_latency: Curated metadata; hours for most categories
meta.resolution: Point or polygon per observation date
meta.historical_depth: Closed events queryable by date range
meta.rate_limits: No published limit. ATLAS polls every 20 minutes.

reliability.rationale: Curated aggregator; quality depends on the referenced primary source

limitations: Wildfire events are dominated by U.S. (IRWIN/InciWeb) and Canadian sources.
Magnitude fields are source-specific (kts for storms, acres for fires).

meta.name: NASA FIRMS — Active Fire Detections (VIIRS & MODIS)
meta.attribution: We acknowledge the use of data from the NASA LANCE FIRMS (https://earthdata.nasa.gov/firms), part of the NASA Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).
meta.update_interval: Continuous as satellite overpasses are processed; ATLAS refreshes every 30 minutes
meta.expected_latency: Near-real-time: typically within 3 hours of satellite overpass

coverage.temporal: Public files: last 24 h / 48 h / 7 days

meta.historical_depth: Archive back to 2000 (MODIS) / 2012 (VIIRS) via the MAP_KEY API or archive download
meta.rate_limits: Public global CSV files require no key. Optional MAP_KEY API is subject to a per-key transaction quota.
meta.cache_strategy: TTL 25 min, ETag revalidation (files are ~1–8 MB)

reliability.rationale: Standard NASA active-fire product with documented algorithms

limitations: A detection marks a pixel containing one or more thermal anomalies, not a fire perimeter.
Near-real-time data does not distinguish vegetation fires from gas flares, volcanoes or industrial heat.
Cloud and smoke obscure detections; absence of detections is not absence of fire.
Fire clusters and their areas are ATLAS-derived groupings of detections.

meta.name: NOAA National Hurricane Center — Active Storms
meta.attribution: Tropical cyclone advisories: NOAA National Hurricane Center
meta.update_interval: Every 6 hours (3-hourly intermediate advisories during watches/warnings)

coverage.geographic: Atlantic, Eastern and Central Pacific basins

meta.resolution: Advisory point positions; forecast cones published as GIS
meta.rate_limits: No published limit. ATLAS polls every 15 minutes.

reliability.rationale: Official WMO Regional Specialized Meteorological Centre for its basins

limitations: Covers NHC/CPHC basins only; other basins come from GDACS and EONET.
Forecast tracks and cones are forecasts by NHC, not certainties.

meta.name: Smithsonian / USGS Weekly Volcanic Activity Report
meta.provider: Smithsonian Institution Global Volcanism Program & USGS

license.name: Public domain (product of U.S. Government employees); citation requested

meta.attribution: Global Volcanism Program, Weekly Volcanic Activity Report. Smithsonian Institution and US Geological Survey.
meta.rate_limits: No published limit. ATLAS polls every 6 hours.

reliability.rationale: Curated reports compiled from volcano observatories

limitations: Weekly cadence: not suitable for real-time eruption alerting.
Reports summarise observatory statements; consult the local observatory for alerts.

meta.name: NASA GIBS — Global Imagery Browse Services
meta.attribution: Imagery: NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA ESDIS
meta.update_interval: Daily (most products); sub-daily for some (e.g. IMERG 30-min)
meta.historical_depth: Full mission archive per layer, time-addressable via WMTS TIME dimension
meta.rate_limits: Tiles are CDN-served; no key required.
meta.cache_strategy: Browser HTTP cache; tiles requested only for the visible viewport

reliability.rationale: Operational NASA imagery service

limitations: Visualisations are rendered images, not calibrated science data values.

meta.name: EOxCloudless — Sentinel-2 cloudless mosaic (2024)
meta.provider: EOX IT Services GmbH (contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data)

license.name: Free for non-commercial use with attribution (EOX licence terms)
license.notes: Commercial deployments require a licence from EOX. ATLAS loads these tiles in the browser only; nothing is redistributed.

meta.attribution: EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2024)
meta.rate_limits: Public WMTS; tiles requested only for the visible viewport

reliability.rationale: Widely used cloud-free basemap from Copernicus Sentinel-2

limitations: A cloud-free composite of many dates: it shows typical surface appearance, not current conditions.

meta.name: Natural Earth — Admin-0 countries & populated places
meta.attribution: Made with Natural Earth
meta.rate_limits: Downloaded once during setup

reliability.rationale: Widely used cartographic reference

limitations: Boundaries reflect de facto control as mapped by Natural Earth and are not an endorsement of any claim.
Generalised geometry: points within a few km of a border may be attributed to the neighbouring country.

meta.name: Open-Meteo Forecast API

license.name: CC BY 4.0 (data); free API for non-commercial use

meta.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0)

coverage.temporal: Forecast up to 16 days; archive since 1940 (ERA5)

meta.resolution: 1–11 km depending on the underlying weather model
meta.historical_depth: ERA5 reanalysis back to 1940 via the archive API
meta.rate_limits: 10,000 calls/day on the free tier. ATLAS fetches per incident on demand and caches 30 minutes.

reliability.rationale: Aggregates national weather models; values are model output

limitations: All values are numerical weather model output (MODEL provenance), not station observations.

meta.name: ReliefWeb API v2

license.name: Per-document terms; API terms of use apply

meta.attribution: Humanitarian reports: ReliefWeb (UN OCHA) and original publishers
meta.rate_limits: 1,000 calls/day per appname

reliability.rationale: Curated humanitarian information service

limitations: Since v2, requests without a pre-approved appname are rejected (HTTP 403). Disabled until configured.

disabled_reason: Requires a free approved appname (set ATLAS_RELIEFWEB_APPNAME)

meta.name: OpenAQ v3
meta.attribution: Air quality data: OpenAQ and contributing providers
meta.rate_limits: 60/min, 2,000/hour per free key

reliability.rationale: Aggregated reference and low-cost sensors

limitations: v3 requires a free API key. Disabled until configured.

meta.name: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API
meta.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
meta.rate_limits: Public instance: small number of concurrent slots per IP; heavy use must self-host.

reliability.rationale: Crowd-sourced; completeness varies strongly by country

limitations: Absence of a mapped facility does not mean the facility does not exist.

meta.name: GHSL GHS-POP R2023A (2025 epoch, 30 arc-second)
meta.attribution: Schiavina M. et al. (2023): GHS-POP R2023A. European Commission, Joint Research Centre (JRC)
meta.rate_limits: Single ~484 MB download (optional Population Pack)

reliability.rationale: Peer-reviewed global population grid

limitations: Population grids are modelled estimates (MODEL provenance) disaggregated from census data.
Exposure counts are residential population; daytime and seasonal populations differ.

meta.name: Terrain Tiles (Terrarium) on AWS Open Data
meta.provider: Mapzen / Linux Foundation (tilezen) on the AWS Open Data Sponsorship Program

license.name: Mixed open licences per source (see attribution list)

meta.attribution: Terrain: Terrain Tiles on AWS Open Data. USGS 3DEP, GMTED2010 and SRTM; NOAA ETOPO1; Copernicus EU-DEM; ArcticDEM; Geoscience Australia; Natural Resources Canada; INEGI; LINZ; Kartverket; UK Environment Agency; offene Daten Österreichs

coverage.temporal: Static composite of the listed DEMs

meta.resolution: ≈ 19 m at the zoom 13 used by ATLAS (source DEMs 1 m – 1 km)
meta.rate_limits: Public S3 bucket; requested only for visible tiles while 3D terrain is on
meta.cache_strategy: Decoded tiles kept in an in-memory LRU in the browser (384 tiles)

reliability.rationale: Static community dataset on AWS; no SLA

limitations: Heights below sea level are clamped to 0 m in ATLAS so imagery is never draped over bathymetry.
Source resolution varies strongly by country.
Visual relief only: not suitable for engineering or hydrological analysis.

meta.name: Sentinel-1 RTC radar via Microsoft Planetary Computer
meta.provider: ESA Copernicus (Sentinel-1) · Catalyst (terrain correction) · Microsoft Planetary Computer

license.name: CC BY 4.0 (Sentinel-1 RTC on the Planetary Computer)

meta.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data; radiometric terrain correction by Catalyst; Microsoft Planetary Computer
meta.update_interval: New passes within about a day; each place revisited every few days (Sentinel-1C/1D)
meta.rate_limits: Anonymous short-lived SAS tokens; ATLAS reads small windows around one incident, on demand
meta.cache_strategy: Analysis results cached on disk per incident; access token cached 15 min

reliability.rationale: Operational ESA mission; Microsoft-hosted analysis-ready archive

limitations: Smooth dry surfaces (sand, tarmac) look like water; flooded vegetation and towns often look brighter and are missed.
Wind-roughened water and radar shadow on steep slopes confuse the water threshold.
The -18 dB VV water threshold is a common default, not calibrated per place.

meta.name: Sentinel-2 L2A via Earth Search (STAC) and AWS COGs
meta.provider: Element 84 (STAC API) · ESA Copernicus (Sentinel-2) · AWS Open Data

license.name: Copernicus Sentinel data terms (free, full and open)

meta.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data, processed by ATLAS. Catalogue: Element 84 Earth Search on AWS Open Data
meta.update_interval: New scenes within hours of acquisition; each place revisited about every 5 days
meta.expected_latency: Hours to a day after acquisition
meta.resolution: 10 m (visible, NIR) and 20 m (SWIR, scene classification)
meta.rate_limits: Public STAC API and public COG bucket; ATLAS reads small windows around one incident, on demand
meta.cache_strategy: Analysis results cached on disk for 24 h per incident and index

reliability.rationale: Operational ESA mission; widely used public catalogue

limitations: Clouds, cloud shadows, smoke and snow hide the surface; masked pixels are excluded and the valid fraction is reported.
Change between two dates also reflects season, harvest, tides and illumination, not only the hazard.
Index thresholds are published conventions (USGS dNBR classes, MNDWI > 0) and are not calibrated for every landscape.

meta.name: EMSC-CSEM earthquakes (FDSN event service)
meta.attribution: Earthquake data: EMSC-CSEM (European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre), CC BY 4.0
meta.update_interval: Real time (automatic solutions revised within minutes)

coverage.geographic: Global; densest in the Euro-Mediterranean region

meta.rate_limits: Polled every 5 min for the last 24 h, M ≥ 4.0

reliability.rationale: Established seismological agency; independent of USGS

limitations: Automatic solutions are revised; magnitude types (mb, Mw, ML) differ from USGS for the same event.
Incident threshold M ≥ 4.5, as for USGS; smaller events corroborate only.

meta.name: NOAA Tsunami Warning Centers (NTWC & PTWC)
meta.provider: NOAA National Weather Service — National Tsunami Warning Center and Pacific Tsunami Warning Center
meta.attribution: Tsunami messages: NOAA National Tsunami Warning Center and Pacific Tsunami Warning Center (tsunami.gov)

coverage.geographic: Messages for U.S. and Pacific/Caribbean areas of responsibility; information statements for large global events

meta.rate_limits: Two small Atom feeds polled every 3 min

reliability.rationale: Official warning authority

limitations: ATLAS links to the official bulletin and never rewrites tsunami guidance.
Other national tsunami warning systems (Japan, Indonesia, Chile, India…) are not yet ingested; always follow your national authority.

meta.name: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center — NOAA scales
meta.provider: NOAA National Weather Service — Space Weather Prediction Center
meta.attribution: Space weather: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (SWPC)
meta.resolution: NOAA R, S and G scales (0–5)
meta.rate_limits: One small JSON, cached 10 min, fetched when the overview is open

reliability.rationale: Official space weather authority

limitations: Shown as context on the overview, not as incidents: geomagnetic storms have no single location.
The outlook is SWPC's forecast, quoted as issued; ATLAS adds no prediction.

meta.name: CelesTrak — NORAD two-line element sets

license.name: Free public data (derived from U.S. Space Force public catalog)

meta.attribution: Orbits: CelesTrak (NORAD two-line elements)
meta.rate_limits: Please do not request the same data more than every 2 hours; ATLAS caches for 6 h

reliability.rationale: Long-standing public orbital data service

limitations: Ground tracks and overpass times are predictions from public orbits (a few km accuracy for days); whether an image is actually taken depends on each mission's acquisition plan and on clouds.

meta.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (AWS Open Data)
meta.provider: European Space Agency / Copernicus (data © DLR, Airbus)
meta.attribution: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 © DLR e.V. 2010–2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014–2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA
meta.rate_limits: One pixel read per right-click (cached)

reliability.rationale: Official Copernicus product on AWS Open Data

limitations: A surface model: heights include buildings and trees.
Land only: open water has no tile.

meta.name: US National Weather Service active alerts
meta.attribution: Alerts: US National Weather Service
meta.resolution: Warning polygons where issued; otherwise forecast zones
meta.rate_limits: One GeoJSON request, cached 5 min, with an identifying User-Agent as NWS asks

reliability.rationale: Official US warning authority

limitations: Only alerts with a polygon are matched to places; zone-only alerts are listed by area name.
ATLAS relays official alerts; it never issues or edits them.

meta.name: MeteoAlarm — European weather warnings

license.name: Terms equivalent to CC BY 4.0, with additional redistribution requirements

meta.attribution: Warnings: MeteoAlarm.org (EUMETNET) and national weather services
meta.rate_limits: One JSON feed per country, fetched only for the country of an incident, cached 10 min

reliability.rationale: Official warnings of European national weather services

limitations: Warnings are given for regions without polygons here, so they are listed for the country, not matched to the exact point.
Not included in the public static snapshot because of MeteoAlarm's redistribution terms.

meta.name: NDMA SACHET — India's integrated public alerts (CAP)
meta.provider: National Disaster Management Authority, Government of India (with IMD, CWC, INCOIS and state SDMAs)

license.name: Public domain (as stated in the SACHET feed)

meta.attribution: Alerts: NDMA SACHET (Government of India) and the issuing agencies
meta.rate_limits: RSS every 10 min; each CAP message and polygon fetched once and cached

reliability.rationale: India's official common alerting system

limitations: Many alerts are short-lived nowcasts (3 hours); expired alerts are hidden.
IMD district warnings reach ATLAS through SACHET; IMD's own APIs require IP whitelisting.

meta.name: Volcanic ash SIGMETs (international aviation warnings)
meta.provider: NOAA Aviation Weather Center (relaying meteorological watch offices worldwide)
meta.attribution: Volcanic ash SIGMETs: NOAA Aviation Weather Center and issuing watch offices
meta.rate_limits: One JSON request, cached 10 min

reliability.rationale: Official aviation warnings derived from VAAC advisories

limitations: Aviation warnings for airspace, not ground ash-fall forecasts.
Full VAAC advisories are linked, not parsed.

meta.name: Japan Meteorological Agency — earthquake and tsunami information

license.name: Government of Japan Standard Terms of Use 2.0 (compatible with CC BY 4.0)

meta.attribution: Earthquake information: Japan Meteorological Agency
meta.rate_limits: One JSON list, cached 1 min, fetched when a Japan earthquake is opened

reliability.rationale: Official seismic authority of Japan

limitations: Shown alongside USGS/EMSC for Japan earthquakes; JMA magnitudes (Mj) differ from moment magnitude.

meta.name: National Center for Seismology (India)
meta.provider: National Center for Seismology, Ministry of Earth Sciences, Government of India

license.name: Government of India website content (no explicit open licence published; shown with attribution and links)

meta.attribution: Earthquake information: National Center for Seismology, Government of India
meta.rate_limits: One page, cached 5 min, fetched when an earthquake near India is opened

reliability.rationale: India's official seismic authority

limitations: Read from the event list on NCS's public page (no documented API), so a site change can break it; ATLAS then says so.
Times are published in IST and converted to UTC.

meta.name: INCOIS Indian Tsunami Early Warning Centre
meta.provider: Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services, Ministry of Earth Sciences

license.name: Government of India website content (no explicit open licence published; shown with attribution and links)

meta.attribution: Tsunami bulletins: INCOIS Indian Tsunami Early Warning Centre

coverage.geographic: Indian Ocean and global large earthquakes

meta.rate_limits: One JSON list, cached 5 min

reliability.rationale: Official tsunami warning centre for the Indian Ocean

limitations: ATLAS lists INCOIS bulletins and links to them; it does not interpret threat levels or ocean-state forecasts.

meta.name: IOC Sea Level Station Monitoring Facility
meta.provider: UNESCO Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission and station operators

license.name: Free and open; acknowledge the IOC SLSMF and the station operators

meta.attribution: Sea level: IOC Sea Level Station Monitoring Facility and station operators
meta.resolution: Raw sea level at each station
meta.rate_limits: Station list cached 1 day; one station's last 24 h on request

reliability.rationale: Raw, unquality-controlled real-time data

limitations: Raw real-time data, not quality-controlled; tides are not removed.

meta.name: NOAA DART tsunami buoys
meta.attribution: Tsunami buoys: NOAA National Data Buoy Center (DART)

coverage.geographic: Pacific, Atlantic and Indian Ocean deep-ocean stations

meta.rate_limits: Station file on request, cached 5 min

reliability.rationale: Operational tsunami detection network

limitations: Water-column height includes tides; a tsunami shows as a short departure from them.

meta.name: GloFAS river discharge via Open-Meteo Flood API
meta.attribution: River discharge: Copernicus GloFAS via Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0)
meta.resolution: Daily discharge (m³/s) at the nearest river cell
meta.rate_limits: One request per incident, cached 3 h; free non-commercial use

reliability.rationale: Hydrological model output, not gauge measurements

limitations: Modelled discharge for the nearest 5 km river cell, which may not be the river that flooded.
The forecast is GloFAS's, shown as issued.

meta.name: USGS Water Data (river gauges)
meta.attribution: River gauges: U.S. Geological Survey
meta.resolution: Gauge height and discharge at stations
meta.rate_limits: One bounded request per incident, cached 15 min

reliability.rationale: Official US stream gauge network

limitations: Provisional data subject to revision.
Only within the United States.

meta.name: WorldPop population (stats API)
meta.attribution: Population: WorldPop (www.worldpop.org), CC BY 4.0
meta.rate_limits: One request per comparison, cached 30 days

reliability.rationale: Peer-reviewed model; differs from GHSL by design

limitations: A second population model to compare with GHSL; differences reflect method and year, not error in one of them.

meta.name: EFFIS — European Forest Fire Information System
meta.provider: Copernicus Emergency Management Service — Joint Research Centre

license.name: Free use with acknowledgement (© European Union, Copernicus EMS)

meta.attribution: Fire danger and burnt areas: EFFIS, Copernicus Emergency Management Service (© European Union)

coverage.geographic: Global (fire danger); Europe, Middle East and North Africa (burnt areas)

meta.rate_limits: Map tiles requested by the browser while the layer is on

reliability.rationale: Official EU fire information service

limitations: Fire Weather Index is a model of fire danger, not a forecast of fires.
Burnt areas are mapped from MODIS/VIIRS and exclude small fires.

meta.name: Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping activations
meta.provider: European Commission — Copernicus Emergency Management Service

license.name: Free and open (© European Union, Copernicus EMS)

meta.attribution: Emergency mapping: Copernicus Emergency Management Service (© European Union)
meta.resolution: Areas of interest with delineation and grading maps
meta.rate_limits: Activation list cached 30 min; one activation's details on request

reliability.rationale: Official EU emergency mapping service

limitations: Activations happen on request by authorities, so most incidents have none.
ATLAS links the official maps; it does not redraw them.

meta.name: HDX Humanitarian API (HAPI)

license.name: Per dataset (mostly CC BY 4.0 / CC BY-IGO)

meta.attribution: Humanitarian data: HDX HAPI (OCHA) and the contributing organisations
meta.rate_limits: A few requests per country, cached 1 day

auth.how_to_get: Generate one at https://hapi.humdata.org/docs (encode_app_identifier) with your app name and email

reliability.rationale: Curated humanitarian indicators from many organisations

limitations: Needs a free app identifier (your app name and email, base64-encoded by HDX); without it the card stays off.

meta.name: Overture Maps building footprints
meta.provider: Overture Maps Foundation (merging OpenStreetMap, Microsoft and Google Open Buildings, Esri Community Maps)
meta.attribution: Buildings: Overture Maps Foundation (ODbL; includes © OpenStreetMap contributors, Microsoft and Google Open Buildings)
meta.rate_limits: Public AWS Open Data bucket; DuckDB reads only row groups intersecting the area, on request
meta.cache_strategy: DuckDB metadata cache for the session; first query about a minute, then seconds

reliability.rationale: Large merged open dataset; coverage uneven by country

limitations: Mapped footprints only; completeness varies widely by country and source.
A count of buildings is not a count of damaged buildings.
